verses.text: <ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>一<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yì</rt></ruby><ruby>发<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fā</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>空<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>便<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>多<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duō</rt></ruby><ruby>水<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>激<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>动<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dònɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>云<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yún</rt></ruby><ruby>雾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>腾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ténɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>电<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diàn</rt></ruby><ruby>随<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suí</rt></ruby><ruby>雨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>而<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>闪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǎn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>府<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>库<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kù</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>风<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Gè</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>成<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby><ruby>畜<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chù</rt></ruby><ruby>类<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lei</rt></ruby>，<ruby>毫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">háo</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>识<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby>；<ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby><ruby>银<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yín</rt></ruby><ruby>匠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>雕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">diāo</rt></ruby><ruby>刻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>偶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>羞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiū</rt></ruby><ruby>愧<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kuì</rt></ruby>。<ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Tā</rt></ruby><ruby>所<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>铸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>偶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>本<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">běn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>假<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby>，<ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>并<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>气<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qì</rt></ruby><ruby>息<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xī</rt></ruby>，

<ruby>都<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dōu</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>虚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby>，<ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>迷<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mí</rt></ruby><ruby>惑<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huo</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>工<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby>；<ruby>到<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Dào</rt></ruby><ruby>追<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuī</rt></ruby><ruby>讨<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>除<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chú</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby>。

<mark class="pn"><ruby>雅<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>各<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>份<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">fèn</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bú</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>些<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiē</rt></ruby>，<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>造<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zào</rt></ruby><ruby>作<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zuò</rt></ruby><ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>主<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhǔ</rt></ruby>。<mark class="pn"><ruby>以<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>色<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sè</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>产<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>业<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>支<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>派<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pài</rt></ruby>，<ruby>万<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wàn</rt></ruby><ruby>军<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jūn</rt></ruby><ruby>之<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>名<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mínɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>围<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wéi</rt></ruby><ruby>困<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kùn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>当<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>收<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shōu</rt></ruby><ruby>拾<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>财<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cái</rt></ruby><ruby>物<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>带<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dài</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>。
verses.heading: 预告被掳

verses.text: <ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>时<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shí</rt></ruby><ruby>候<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hou</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>此<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>居<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jū</rt></ruby><ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">mín</rt></ruby>，<ruby>好<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hǎo</rt></ruby><ruby>像<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>用<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>机<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>弦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xián</rt></ruby><ruby>甩<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuǎi</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>又<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yòu</rt></ruby><ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>加<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiā</rt></ruby><ruby>害<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hài</rt></ruby><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>身<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēn</rt></ruby><ruby>上<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shànɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>使<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>觉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>悟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wù</rt></ruby>。”

<ruby>民<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Mín</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>祸<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Huò</rt></ruby><ruby>哉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zāi</rt></ruby>！<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby><ruby>损<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sǔn</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>伤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>痕<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hén</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>其<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qí</rt></ruby><ruby>重<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby>。”<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>却<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">què</rt></ruby><ruby>说<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shuō</rt></ruby>：“<ruby>这<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Zhè</rt></ruby><ruby>真<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēn</rt></ruby><ruby>是<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shì</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>痛<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tònɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>苦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǔ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>必<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bì</rt></ruby><ruby>须<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xū</rt></ruby><ruby>忍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rěn</rt></ruby><ruby>受<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shòu</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby>；<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>绳<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shénɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>索<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">suǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>折<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhé</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby>。<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>儿<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ér</rt></ruby><ruby>女<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǚ</rt></ruby><ruby>离<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lí</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>出<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chū</rt></ruby><ruby>去<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qù</rt></ruby>，<ruby>没<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">méi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>了<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">le</rt></ruby>。<ruby>无<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wú</rt></ruby><ruby>人<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rén</rt></ruby><ruby>再<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>支<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>搭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dā</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>帐<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>棚<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pénɡ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>挂<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuà</rt></ruby><ruby>起<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">qǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>幔<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">màn</rt></ruby><ruby>子<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zi</rt></ruby>。

verses.text: <ruby>境<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>内<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nèi</rt></ruby><ruby>有<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǒu</rt></ruby><ruby>打<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dǎ</rt></ruby><ruby>仗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhànɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>响<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xiǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>声<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shēnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>全<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Quán</rt></ruby><ruby>地<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dì</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>大<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">dà</rt></ruby><ruby>锤<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chuí</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>竟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>砍<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>断<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duàn</rt></ruby><ruby>破<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">pò</rt></ruby><ruby>坏<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huài</rt></ruby>？<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>在<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zài</rt></ruby><ruby>列<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liè</rt></ruby><ruby>国<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡuó</rt></ruby><ruby>中<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>何<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>竟<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>荒<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>凉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liánɡ</rt></ruby>？

<mark class="pn"><ruby>巴<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Bā</rt></ruby><ruby>比<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>伦<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lún</rt></ruby></mark><ruby>哪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nɑ</rt></ruby>，<ruby>我<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǒ</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>设<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">shè</rt></ruby><ruby>下<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xià</rt></ruby><ruby>网<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wǎnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>罗<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">luó</rt></ruby>，<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>知<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhī</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>觉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jué</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>缠<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">chán</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>。<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>寻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">xún</rt></ruby><ruby>着<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zháo</rt></ruby>，<ruby>也<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yě</rt></ruby><ruby>被<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bèi</rt></ruby><ruby>捉<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhuō</rt></ruby><ruby>住<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhù</rt></ruby>；<ruby>因<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yīn</rt></ruby><ruby>为<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">wèi</rt></ruby><ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>与<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yǔ</rt></ruby><ruby>耶<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Yē</rt></ruby><ruby>和<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">hé</rt></ruby><ruby>华<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huá</rt></ruby><ruby>争<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">zhēnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>竞<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby>。

<ruby>你<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">Nǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>们<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">men</rt></ruby><ruby>要<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yào</rt></ruby><ruby>从<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cónɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>极<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jí</rt></ruby><ruby>远<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">yuǎn</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>边<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">biān</rt></ruby><ruby>界<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiè</rt></ruby><ruby>来<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lái</rt></ruby><ruby>攻<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡōnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>击<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jī</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby>，<ruby>开<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">kāi</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>的<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">de</rt></ruby><ruby>仓<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">cānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>廪<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">lǐn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>将<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jiānɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>他<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">tā</rt></ruby><ruby>堆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duī</rt></ruby><ruby>如<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">rú</rt></ruby><ruby>高<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">ɡāo</rt></ruby><ruby>堆<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">duī</rt></ruby>，<ruby>毁<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">huǐ</rt></ruby><ruby>灭<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">miè</rt></ruby><ruby>净<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìnɡ</rt></ruby><ruby>尽<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">jìn</rt></ruby>，<ruby>丝<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">sī</rt></ruby><ruby>毫<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">háo</rt></ruby><ruby>不<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">bù</rt></ruby><ruby>留<rt class="_idGenRuby-3">liú</rt></ruby>。
